I have nothing on Telltale. The stored knowledge covers only Joad Axle Works and general firm practice, so I can't say what Telltale instructed on expert report review or settlement timing. Another client's instructions would also be confidential to that client, so we shouldn't use them as a template for Joad. Joad's approach should come from Joad's own instructions, which are below.

**Expert review (Joad)**
- Joad wants the names and credentials of all proposed testifying experts before engagement, so build client clearance into the retention timeline.
- Tell Joad whether anyone will speak to industry practice.
- Joad prefers design testimony to stay focused on the product at issue. It has offered to help identify candidates who have served on standards bodies.
- The stored knowledge says nothing about Joad reviewing draft expert reports, so we should ask Evander Thorsby, the General Counsel, whether it wants that and in what form.
- Get quotes and Joad's approval before commissioning any experts or testing. Give 10 days' notice of proposed testing, and clarify who pays for shared lab work.

**Settlement timing (Joad)**
- Confirm the settlement authority for C-2 in writing. The $1,500,000 insurer pre-approval comes from an earlier matter and must be verified.
- Do not communicate any number above the insurer-approved tier, even as a signal, until the board's written sign-off is in hand. Do not rely on verbal indications from directors or officers.
- Even for an offer within the insurer's tier, consult Joad first, because the insurer will want to be involved.
- A figure above the insurer's tier needs about three weeks for the General Counsel to prepare a board consent. The board meets monthly, but it can act in writing between meetings if the chair approves. Flag this early, before negotiations reach that point.
- Copy Perpetua Wallace at Cobaltridge on anything bearing on coverage.

**Other reminders**
- Send all communications to Evander Thorsby.
- The first case assessment, due within 60 days, should include an exposure range and a probability of an adverse result.

If you meant a different client or matter, let me know. If Telltale is a client whose file you're authorized to use, point me to it.
